name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: No red aviation codes on major routes
summary: No red aviation codes on major air routes; no large eruptions
state: No volcano was at aviation colour code red near major air routes as of 4 Nov, and no large explosive eruption was reported in the Smithsonian weekly report or VAAC advisories. Mayon in the Philippines remains at alert level 3 and Kīlauea continues episodic eruptions, neither affecting international routes.
for_you: No action needed. Airlines reroute around ash when advisories are issued.
rubric_hit: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions = Normal

sources.title: Smithsonian GVP — Weekly volcanic activity report

why: Major eruptions ground flights (Iceland 2010) and can cool the climate for years.
drivers: Volcanic unrest; impact depends on ash plume height and jet-stream direction.

rubric.alert: Major airspace closures from ash, or a VEI 4+ eruption.
rubric.watch: Aviation colour code orange/red at a volcano near major air routes, or a large eruption.
rubric.normal: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions.
